rationale: C17 is the strongest candidate because it is an immediately preceding executive order with the same distinctive individualized action—exempting a named official from compulsory retirement for age—with only the person's name changing. C06 and C11 are similarly strong examples of the same reusable directive form, but C17 is closest in date. Although the operative texts are unavailable because these orders were unpublished, the unusually specific matching titles and document type plausibly identify a common drafting template.
